title: Royal Couscous with Cauliflower and Peppery Notes
description: A hearty French-inspired couscous dish infused with moroccan spices and the subtle flavor of royal ingredients. A perfect meal for a chilly evening.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil, then cook the couscous according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the cauliflower florets and cook until tender.
In a small bowl, mix together the Moroccan spice mix and a pinch of salt. Sprinkle over the cauliflower and stir to combine.
Fluff the cooked couscous with a fork and transfer it to a large serving dish. Top with the cooked cauliflower mixture.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
